info.name: Hintro Mock API
info.description:
Complete API collection for the Hintro Mock Backend.

Base URL: https://mock-backend-hintro.vercel.app

All endpoints require the `x-user-id` header:
- `u1` → Empty state (no call history)
- `u2` → Filled state (real data)

Set the `userId` collection variable to switch between users.

variable.description: Base URL of the Hintro Mock API
Active user ID — u1 (empty state) or u2 (filled state)
Number of call sessions per page
A specific call session ID for detail lookup

request.description: Verify the API server is running. No authentication required.

Returns the user profile for the given `x-user-id`.

**Response fields:**
- `id` — User ID
- `email` — User email
- `firstName` / `lastName` — Display name
- `login_method` — `google` or `email`
- `status` — `active`
- `createdAt` / `updatedAt`

Returns an aggregated dashboard payload with user info, subscription details, and usage metrics.

**Response fields:**
- `user` — Same as /api/auth/profile
- `subscription.plan` — `free` | `professional`
- `subscription.billing_cycle` — `monthly` | `annual`
- `subscription.status` — `active`
- `usage.kb_files` — `{ used, limit, percentage }`
- `usage.vocab_terms` — Number
- `usage.notes` — Number

Returns aggregate call statistics for the user.

**Response fields:**
- `totalSessions` — Total number of call sessions
- `averageDuration` — Average duration in **seconds** (convert: `Math.floor(s/60)m ${s%60}sec`)
- `totalAIInteractions` — Total AI interactions count
- `lastSession` — Array of ISO date strings (most recent sessions first)

**Example (u2):**
```json
{
  "totalSessions": 12,
  "averageDuration": 3187,
  "totalAIInteractions": 8,
  "lastSession": ["2026-05-09T15:15:11.831Z", ...]
}
```

query.description: Number of sessions per page (default: 10, max: 50)

request.description:
Returns paginated call session history.

**Response shape:**
```json
{
  "callSessions": [ ...sessions ],
  "pagination": {
    "page": 1,
    "limit": 10,
    "totalCount": 10,
    "totalPages": 1,
    "hasNextPage": false,
    "hasPrevPage": false
  }
}
```

**Session fields:**
- `_id` — Session ID (e.g. `cs1`)
- `user_id` — Owner user ID
- `status` — `ended` | `force_ended`
- `client` — Client/company name
- `description` — Call type/description
- `started_at` / `ended_at` — ISO timestamps
- `total_duration_seconds` — Duration in seconds
- `ai_interactions` — AI interaction count
- `participants` — Array of `{ name, isUser }`

Returns full details for a single call session by ID.

Change the `sessionId` collection variable to look up different sessions (e.g. `cs1`, `cs2`, …).
